'''Caske''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], Caske held the rank of [[Major/Legends|Major]] and served within the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. He served as the High Command's contact for Rebel cells operating in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], passing on any missions or requirements Command had of the cells, and arranging for the delivery of any special equipment they needed.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caske was first mentioned in the campaign guide included in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]] released in [[1997]]. The book was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], and gave Caske as an example ally for any Rebel aligned players, although it did not reveal Caske's [[Species/Legends|species]].
